name: Art Institute of Chicago API
summary: Free REST API for the Art Institute of Chicago's collection, exhibitions, artists and IIIF images.
description: Artworks, artists, agents, galleries, exhibitions and events with Elasticsearch-style search, field selection and IIIF image identifiers. Covers 133k+ artworks. Data is CC0 and descriptions are CC BY 4.0.

rate_limit.summary: 60 requests/minute for anonymous clients (x-ratelimit-limit: 60 header observed).

example.response_excerpt: {"data":{"id":27992,"title":"A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884","date_display":"1884–86, border added 1888–89","artist_display":"Georges Seurat (French, 1859–1891)"}}

agent_notes: Use fields= to limit payloads. Images come from IIIF: https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/{image_id}/full/843,/0/default.jpg, where image_id is a field on the artwork. An AIC-User-Agent header identifying your app is suggested.
caveats: The /api-docs path returns 404; the documentation is at /docs/.
Nightly data dumps are also published on GitHub.
